[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/mg061fe039o.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/mg061fe039o.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/mg061fe039o.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Solomatova et al. (2016), fei hs BM3 reference branch

**reproduced** · `mg061fe039o_solomatova_2016_fei_hs_bm3_reference_1` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mg061fe039o.md#record-mg061fe039o_solomatova_2016_fei_hs_bm3_reference_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.

- Every compared free coefficient lies inside its positive printed source error width. Target-branch agreement only, conditional on the existing coupled approximate-volume fit and Table 2 priors. Fixed LS K0-prime=4, and the Fp48 HS V0 anchor where applicable, are constraints, not independently recovered values. Prior regularization supports agreement and does not independently validate the endmembers or full spin-crossover fit. Reconstruction covariance remains unknown; this is a source-width central-value comparison, not combined-error or author-workflow parity. Earlier audit wording (superseded only for the named numerical scope): Coupled three-level spin-state reconstruction using the recovered earlier observations and Solomatova Table 2 priors. The original MINUTI input, row weights, residual definition, and covariance are unpublished, so this equal-weight approximate-volume fit tests numerical similarity rather than claiming an exact reproduction.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mg061fe039o\_fei\_2007\_table\_s2\_pv
- **Observations:** 38
- **Fit kind:** coupled\_bm3\_three\_level\_spin\_crossover
- **Selection:** compression\_path=1
- **Objective:** equal-weight approximate volume residuals plus Table 2 priors
- **Free parameters:** V0\_HS; K0\_HS; K0\_prime\_HS; V0\_LS; K0\_LS; omega0
- **Fixed parameters:** None declared

### Curves and residuals

![Source and refit curves with native-coordinate residuals for mg061fe039o_solomatova_2016_fei_hs_bm3_reference_1](figures/mg061fe039o_solomatova_2016_fei_hs_bm3_reference_1-curves.svg#only-light)
![Source and refit curves with native-coordinate residuals for mg061fe039o_solomatova_2016_fei_hs_bm3_reference_1](figures/mg061fe039o_solomatova_2016_fei_hs_bm3_reference_1-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Output / replay scope | Points | Residual units | Source RMS | Refit RMS |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Coupled three-level spin-crossover trajectory | 38 | GPa | 1.16 | 0.96 |

The plotted curve is the complete coupled mixed-spin trajectory; this record's coefficient table describes one HS/LS reference endmember. The source-constrained diagnostic uses both Table 7 endmembers and the Table 2 midpoint. The refit's internal omega0, omitted from the ledger, is recovered algebraically from both stored endmembers and its stored 50% transition pressure. No optimizer is run. Vertical pressure RMS is descriptive; the original audit minimized approximate volume residuals plus priors, and exact MINUTI weights/workflow remain unknown.
